canonical_spec.title: Leadership portfolio
canonical_spec.outcome: Defend strategy, resources, governance and crisis decisions and reflect on real responsibility.
canonical_spec.deliverables: Strategy memo, budget, governance map, hiring/incentive plan, crisis exercise and observed real-responsibility retrospective.

architecture: Distinct actual-work cross-volume leadership capstone, not a synthetic rehearsal pass. Require own strategy memo, original/revised/actual reconciled budget, governance/authority map, hiring/incentive/people plan, permitted crisis exercise and actual responsibility retrospective. Academic and financial analytical breadth must be demonstrated; actual observed responsibility may be one appropriately bounded setting, with unobserved settings explicitly excluded from readiness. Link complete V18 chapter/project rehearsals rather than count them as learner work.

Six complete artifact contracts and reusable blank candidate/assessor forms: actual role and permission, dates, versions, original records, assumptions, decision/action/outcome separation, team contributions, assistance, reviewer expertise/relationships/access, adverse evidence, actual feedback and implemented versus proposed response. Actual real project ownership and at least one identifiable informed external-to-owner human observation/review required; no invented permission/signature/performance. Real hiring/financial control authority is never granted by a book.

Operational staged evidence agreement/submission/full inspection/human review/defense/disagreement resolution/disposition. Qualitative anchored supported-within-scope/revise/not-evaluable judgments by strategy/resources/governance/people/evidence domains. Averages cannot cure fabricated evidence, unsupported causal attribution, unreconciled material budgets or missing real responsibility. Scope/conditions of next assignment explicit; assessor invitation not acceptance and planned correction not implemented.

Three complete original fictional assessor calibration dossiers, with substantial economic/financial decisions and original full artifacts, complete ledger/proof, dated actions/outcomes, full human reviewer text and complete disposition/response. Case1 strong academic option design but no real execution evidence; Case2 actual-in-fiction financial change project with material budget/authority/control breach and required repair; Case3 bounded observed delivery and people-feedback repair with supported narrow readiness but no universal skill or causal impact claim. Distinct from V18C11/C12 and finalvolume rehearsal. Include meaningful global optimality/boundary/counterfactual reasoning, all raw inputs and full worked solutions.

Six operational defense prompts and full benchmark answers plus actual-candidate blank defense form. Map six prerequisite volumes and all12V18chapters to evidence/remediation. Time/workload internal uncalibrated; no universal appointment or credential promise. Retain precisely scoped source inspector attribution; use original fictional policy excerpts, not unverified current legal claims.

Fourfile quietcheck(root=None)/silentCLI, three nonself hashes/strictJSON. Independent primitive calculation tests all displayed numerical groups, complete prompt-solution pairs and meaningful alternative/invalid cases. Actually normal/default/explicit and exact4 isolated -I -B -O APIs/silentCLI from /, byte/inventory unchanged. Full prose/proof/task review separate; distinct peer required before canonical promotion.
